identity.operation: Report an XInclude processing memory error.
identity.condition: An XInclude allocation fails after processing is reached.
identity.capability: Record XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY in ctxt->errNo for xmlXIncludeGetLastError.
identity.consequence: The existing allocation-failure assertion may abort.

requirement: An XInclude allocation failure remains recognizable as XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY by the existing XInclude-context check.

assessment.necessity_reason: The old harness checks the XInclude context error code after an injected allocation failure. The before helper sets that code; the after helper only raises a memory error. The supplied evidence does not establish that the harness's document-node argument passes the unchanged guard or reaches an injected XInclude failure.

before.requirement: Report a reached XInclude allocation failure as XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY in ctxt->errNo for the existing harness check.
before.reason: The helper sets ctxt->errNo, but reachability through the harness's document-node call is unresolved.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Processing returns before the helper can run when the supplied node's doc field is NULL.
A failed base allocation would invoke the memory-error helper after the entry guard.

after.requirement: Report a reached XInclude allocation failure as XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY in ctxt->errNo so the existing harness check remains true.
after.reason: The changed helper does not assign ctxt->errNo, and its delegated call passes NULL for the optional error structure. Whether the old harness reaches this failure path is unresolved.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The delegated routine updates the global error; it updates an optional error structure only when that argument is non-NULL.
The same node->doc guard remains before processing.
A failed base allocation would invoke the changed helper after the entry guard.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Fuzz input selects the allocation-failure limit.
A mismatch in the existing allocation-failure check aborts the harness.

assessment.comparison_reason: The same frozen error-reporting obligation is assessed on both sides. The changed helper removes the ctxt->errNo assignment, but the document construction and guard outcome needed to establish an old-harness witness are missing.
missing_information: The doc field of a document returned by xmlCtxtReadMemory, through xmlDoRead and document creation.
A finite input and allocation limit that reach an XInclude allocation failure after the guard.

necessity_evidence.reason: The changed memory-error helper no longer sets the context error code read by the existing assertion. The packet does not establish that the harness's document-node argument passes the unchanged node->doc guard, so no finite failing target execution is established.

scope_contract.reason: XInclude processing and its context error-code check are existing target operations.

evidence.dependency_reason: The accessor used by the harness reads ctxt->errNo.

feasible_trigger.reason: Input selects an allocation limit, and a failed XInclude base allocation calls the changed helper. Whether the document node supplied by this harness passes the node->doc guard is unresolved.

evidence.dependency_reason: Processing returns before the failure site if the document node's doc field is NULL.
A failed base allocation would invoke the changed helper after the guard.

observable_consequence.reason: Conditional on reaching the base-allocation failure, the new helper updates a global error but does not set ctxt->errNo; the accessor reads that field, and a mismatch aborts the existing check.

evidence.dependency_reason: The delegated routine updates an optional error structure only when its argument is non-NULL.
The existing check aborts on a mismatch.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: For the conditional base-allocation failure, the processing path returns immediately. The accessor reads only ctxt->errNo, so the global memory error is not an equivalent route for the existing check. The unresolved node->doc guard remains a trigger question.

evidence.dependency_reason: The existing accessor does not read the global error.
The guard is counterevidence to reachability, not an alternative error-reporting route.

identity_preserved.reason: Both source versions are assessed for the same XInclude memory-error report consumed by the same old harness check. Only the helper's context-field update changes in this assessment.

evidence.dependency_reason: The before version has the same entry guard.
The after version retains that guard.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Shows what the replacement memory-error routine updates.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The configured allocator injects a failure at the selected allocation count.
